# prepare data
```{r}
# replace sample name
abund <- read_excel(here('../Input/MAP2B_results/map2b_result_g5_10162025/Abundance.xlsx'))
name <- read_excel(here('../Input/MAP2B_results/Corresponding_table_of_sequencing_samples.xlsx'))

name <- name %>%
  mutate(
    R1_short = str_remove(R1, ".R1.fastq.gz"),
    R2_short = str_remove(R2, ".R2.fastq.gz")
  )

mapping <- name %>%
  select(R1_short, location1) %>%
  rename(sample_old = R1_short, sample_new = location1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample_new))

old_names <- colnames(abund)
new_names <- old_names
for (i in seq_along(old_names)) {
  matched <- mapping$sample_new[match(old_names[i], mapping$sample_old)]
  if (!is.na(matched)) {
    new_names[i] <- matched
  }
}
colnames(abund) <- new_names

write.csv(abund, "../Output/abundance_table_renamed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# get phyloseq
```{r}
# get phyloseq
#abund
abund <- read.csv('../Output/abundance_table_renamed.csv', check.names = FALSE)
colnames(abund)[1] <- "Kingdom"
#meta
meta_data <- read_csv("../Input/metadata.csv") %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(meta_data) <- meta_data$Sample_id

#reorder samples
sample_cols <- colnames(abund)[8:ncol(abund)]
common_samples <- intersect(sample_cols, rownames(meta_data))
common_samples <- rownames(meta_data)[rownames(meta_data) %in% common_samples]
abund_ordered <- abund %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(colnames(abund)[1:7], common_samples)))

identical(colnames(abund_ordered)[8:ncol(abund_ordered)], rownames(meta_data))
write.csv(abund_ordered, '../Output/abund.reorder.csv')

#taxo
tax_cols <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
tax_table_df <- abund_ordered[, tax_cols]
otu_abund_df <- abund_ordered[, !(colnames(abund_ordered) %in% tax_cols)]
#row name
rownames(tax_table_df) <- apply(tax_table_df, 1, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"))
rownames(otu_abund_df) <- rownames(tax_table_df)

# merge in phyloseq
otu <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu_abund_df), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
tax <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_table_df))
smp <- sample_data(meta_data)
ps <- phyloseq(otu, tax, smp)

#info
ps

otu_ids <- colnames(otu_table(ps))
meta_ids <- rownames(sample_data(ps))

setdiff(otu_ids, meta_ids)
setdiff(meta_ids, otu_ids)
identical(otu_ids, meta_ids)

saveRDS(ps, '../Output/physeq_raw.RDS')
```

# decontaminant
```{r}
#remove contaminants using decontam
library(decontam)
ps <- readRDS('../Output/physeq_raw.RDS')

#remove some samples
ps <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(ps) %in% 
                            c("D312", "D1304", "D1423", "D1439", "D1068")), 
                          ps)
ps
colnames(sample_data(ps))
table(sample_data(ps)$race)

head(sample_data(ps))

#Inspect Library Sizes
df <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps)) 
df$LibrarySize <- sample_sums(ps)
df <- df[order(df$LibrarySize),]
df$Index <- seq(nrow(df))
ggplot(data=df, aes(x=Index, y=LibrarySize, color=Sample_or_Control)) + geom_point()

#Identify Contaminants - Prevalence
sample_data(ps)$is.neg <- sample_data(ps)$Sample_or_Control == "Control Sample"
contamdf.prev <- isContaminant(ps, method="prevalence", neg="is.neg", threshold=0.1)
table(contamdf.prev$contaminant)   # 59 contams
head(which(contamdf.prev$contaminant))
sum(contamdf.prev$contaminant) / nrow(contamdf.prev) #p=0.1 2.9%, 0.5: 6.6%

ps.pa <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(abund) 1*(abund>0))
ps.pa.neg <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps.pa)$Sample_or_Control == "Control Sample", ps.pa)
ps.pa.pos <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps.pa)$Sample_or_Control == "True Sample", ps.pa)
# Make data.frame of prevalence in positive and negative samples
df.pa <- data.frame(pa.pos=taxa_sums(ps.pa.pos), pa.neg=taxa_sums(ps.pa.neg),
                      contaminant=contamdf.prev$contaminant)
ggplot(data=df.pa, aes(x=pa.neg, y=pa.pos, color=contaminant)) + geom_point() +
  xlab("Prevalence (Negative Controls)") + ylab("Prevalence (True Samples)")

#reconstruct ps
# get names
contam_taxa <- rownames(contamdf.prev)[contamdf.prev$contaminant == TRUE]

# clean ps
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(!(taxa_names(ps) %in% contam_taxa), ps)

ps_clean
saveRDS(ps_clean, "../Output/phyloseq_cleaned.rds")
# get percent
paste0(round(sum(contamdf.prev$contaminant) / nrow(contamdf.prev) * 100, 2), "% OTUs removed")

# plot
barplot(c(Before = ntaxa(ps), After = ntaxa(ps_clean)),
        col = c("tomato", "seagreen"),
        main = "Number of taxa before and after decontam",
        ylab = "Taxa count")

```

#batch correction
```{r}
## Batch effect correction using MMUPHin package 
library(MMUPHin)
ps_clean <- readRDS("../Output/phyloseq_cleaned.rds")

#remove ctrl
table(sample_data(ps_clean)$Sample_or_Control)

ps_no_neg <- subset_samples(ps_clean, Sample_or_Control != "Control Sample")

# normalization
sample_sums(ps_no_neg) %>% summary()

ps_no_neg <- ps_no_neg %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) {x / sum(x)})

sample_sums(ps_no_neg) %>% summary()


#remove all 0 species
ps_no_neg <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_no_neg) > 0, ps_no_neg)
ps_no_neg

#prepare table
feature_abd <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_no_neg))
meta_data <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_no_neg))

stopifnot(identical(meta_data$Sample_id, colnames(feature_abd)))
identical(colnames(feature_abd), rownames(meta_data))

# get sample_data
meta_data <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_no_neg), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# match row names
meta_data <- meta_data[colnames(feature_abd), , drop = FALSE]

# trans to factors
meta_data$batch <- as.factor(meta_data$batch)

str(meta_data)

species_adj <- adjust_batch(
  feature_abd = feature_abd,
  batch = "batch",            # batch
  covariates = NULL,         
  data = meta_data,
  control = list(verbose = TRUE)
)


# -----------------------------
# get adj abund df
# -----------------------------
feature_abd_adj <- species_adj$feature_abd_adj
write.csv(feature_abd_adj, "../Output/abundance_batch_corrected.csv")

# -----------------------------
# plot
# -----------------------------
# -before
ord1 <- cmdscale(vegdist(t(feature_abd), method = "bray"), k = 2)
df1 <- data.frame(ord1, batch = as.factor(meta_data$batch))
colnames(df1)[1:2] <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

p1 <- ggplot(df1, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggtitle("Before batch correction") +
  theme_bw()
p1
# -after
ord2 <- cmdscale(vegdist(t(feature_abd_adj), method = "bray"), k = 2)
df2 <- data.frame(ord2, batch = as.factor(meta_data$batch))
colnames(df2)[1:2] <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

p2 <- ggplot(df2, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggtitle("After batch correction") +
  theme_bw()

# merge
library(patchwork)
ggsave('batch.pdf', p1 + p2, height = 4, width = 7)
```

# revise tnbc data in meta
```{r}
physeq <- readRDS('../Output/phyloseq_wrong_TNBC.rds')
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    TNBC = case_when(
      ER == "N" & PR == "N" & HER2 == "N" ~ "Y", 
      ER == "Y" | PR == "Y" | HER2 == "Y" ~ "N",  
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
    )
  )

sample_data(physeq) <- sample_data(meta)

saveRDS(physeq, "../Output/physeq.rds")
```

```{r}
# get abund of core tax

get_core_summary <- function(abd_matrix, core_taxa){

  core_abd <- abd_matrix[core_taxa, , drop = FALSE]

  data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(abd_matrix),

    core_mean   = colMeans(core_abd),
    core_median = apply(core_abd, 2, median),

    core_sum    = colSums(core_abd),

    core_richness = colSums(core_abd > 0)
  )
}
summary10 <- get_core_summary(abd_final, core10)
summary20 <- get_core_summary(abd_final, core20)
summary30 <- get_core_summary(abd_final, core30)
summary50 <- get_core_summary(abd_final, core50)



#########export table S1
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
# taxonomy table from physeq (taxa x ranks)
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

# prevalence in true samples (physeq has 38 samples)
prev_df <- data.frame(
  FeatureID = names(prev_final),
  Prevalence = as.numeric(prev_final),
  Prevalence_N = as.integer(rowSums(abd_final > 0)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# abundance summaries in true samples
abd_stats <- data.frame(
  FeatureID = rownames(abd_final),
  Mean_Abundance = rowMeans(abd_final),
  Median_Abundance = apply(abd_final, 1, median),
  Max_Abundance = apply(abd_final, 1, max),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# control overlap flag (presence/absence in negative controls)
ctrl_flag <- data.frame(
  FeatureID = rownames(abd_final),
  Overlap_with_Control = rownames(abd_final) %in% ctrl_detected,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# (optional) control prevalence (how many control samples detected it)
ctrl_prev_df <- data.frame(
  FeatureID = rownames(abd_ctrl),
  Control_Prevalence_N = as.integer(rowSums(abd_ctrl > 0)),
  Control_Prevalence = as.numeric(rowSums(abd_ctrl > 0) / ncol(abd_ctrl)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# master table (one row per species)
master_tbl <- tax_df %>%
  left_join(prev_df, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  left_join(abd_stats, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  left_join(ctrl_flag, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  left_join(ctrl_prev_df, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  mutate(
    Control_Prevalence_N = ifelse(is.na(Control_Prevalence_N), 0L, Control_Prevalence_N),
    Control_Prevalence   = ifelse(is.na(Control_Prevalence), 0, Control_Prevalence),
    Prev_Label = paste0(Prevalence_N, "/", n_samples)
  )

# ---- Table S1: core20
TableS1_core20 <- master_tbl %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% core20) %>%
  mutate(Core_Threshold = ">=20%") %>%
  arrange(desc(Overlap_with_Control), desc(Prevalence), desc(Mean_Abundance))

# ---- Table S1: core50
TableS1_core50 <- master_tbl %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% core50) %>%
  mutate(Core_Threshold = ">=50%") %>%
  arrange(desc(Overlap_with_Control), desc(Prevalence), desc(Mean_Abundance))

# add abund of all samples
abd_wide <- abd_final %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")
master_tbl2 <- master_tbl %>%
  left_join(abd_wide, by = "FeatureID")

TableS1_core20 <- master_tbl2 %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% core20) %>%
  mutate(Core_Threshold = ">=20%") %>%
  arrange(desc(Overlap_with_Control), desc(Prevalence), desc(Mean_Abundance))

TableS1_core50 <- master_tbl2 %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% core50) %>%
  mutate(Core_Threshold = ">=50%") %>%
  arrange(desc(Overlap_with_Control), desc(Prevalence), desc(Mean_Abundance))


# export csv
write.csv(TableS1_core20, "../Output/TableS1_core20_with_control_overlap.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(TableS1_core50, "../Output/TableS1_core50_with_control_overlap.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# quick sanity checks (should be 27 and 9)
sum(TableS1_core20$Overlap_with_Control)  # expect 27
sum(TableS1_core50$Overlap_with_Control)  # expect 9


```
